title: PAST. PRESENT. BECOMING.
passages: Three crows gave the closing stretch a language: past, present, becoming. A garment still waiting to emerge. Costume season beginning. A kilt, a joke, another opportunity to play.

The archive doesn't end with everything resolved. It ends with me still making things. Still entering rooms. Still curious about what comes next. Looking back, I can see the daily practices becoming a life: care for my body, room for expression, work made with my hands, and people willing to share the experience.
Modern Day Circus is the record of that becoming. I am learning how to live a life I can recognize as my own—and how to let myself be seen while I live it.
